shortDescription: Full-size and fully integrated front-load electric/gas Electrolux Laundry Tower™ features a stacked design that takes up half the floor space, freeing up the laundry room for extra storage, all with an easy-to-reach control panel.

features.text: The washer provides the most effective stain removal with SmartBoost® premixing technology* and the dryer with LuxCare® Dry uses an moisture sensor to prevent over or under-drying.
Vertical Stacked Design that Gives You Back Space

Fully integrated vertical layout takes up half the floor space of a traditional washer/dryer for greater laundry room flexibility, or to fit easily into most closets and other tight spaces. Features a full-sized washer on bottom, a full-sized dryer on the top, and a control panel in the middle for easy access.
The Most Effective Stain-Removing Washer with SmartBoost®

Unlike other washers, our SmartBoost® technology premixes water and detergent before the cycle begins, maximizing the cleaning power of the detergent, so stains come out and clothing has a longer life. AHAM HLW-2013 tested against leading front load laundry tower competitors.
Get a More Precise Dry with LuxCare® Dry System
Save time and energy and protect items from over- or under-drying with a sensor that detects humidity on the surface so that all your fabrics are treated with precision and care.
Optic Whites™ Cycle Keeps Whites Whiter than Bleach

Keep your white clothing and linens looking newer longer with our Optic Whites™ cycle, which prevents the redeposit of dirt and other residues, keeping whites even whiter than the normal cycle with bleach.
Instant Refresh Cycle Revives Fabrics Without Washing
Save water and energy with the Instant Refresh dryer cycle, which removes wrinkles and refreshes items from light wear in 10 minutes, without having to do a full wash.
15-Minute Fast Wash and 15-Minute Fast Dry

Just 30 minutes for a wash and dry--quickly deep cleans and dries the items you need most. ^| Fast wash time based on 3 lb. DOE load. Fastest time based on smallest load/Fast Dry cycle selected for various load compositions.
Extra Large Capacity
Easily clean large loads and even a king-sized comforter with extra large capacity (4.5 cu. ft. in the washer and 8.0 cu. Ft. in the dryer).
Remove Bacteria with the Sanitize Washer Setting
Certified to kill and remove 99% of bacteria. ^| Our products meet the NSF® testing standards.
Predictive Dry™ More Accurately Predicts Dry Times
Accurately predicts the dry time depending on the moisture level to achieve optimal drying results.
StainSoak™ Option Eliminates Pre-Treat

Unlike other washers, this setting starts by premixing water, detergent, and stain remover to create a powerful, yet gentle cleaning solution. Then, the temperature, tumbling actions, and time are optimized based on the stain you select.
Remove Allergens with Allergen Option
Remove 95% of allergens from your clothing, towels and bedding with our NSF®-certified Allergen option ^| Our products meet the NSF® testing standards.
World's First Adaptive Dispenser™ Designed to Accept PODS®
Get the ultimate clean no matter what type of detergent you prefer with the Adaptive Dispenser™.
Solid Soil Level Cleans Caked On Stains
Optional Pedestals and Stacking Kit for More Installation Options
Unlike many washers, our Perfect Steam™ rises from the bottom, gently lifting dirt and stains from fibers.
The Solid Soil level gives you a deeper clean to get rid of the those tough stains that get caked on, like mud or dirt.
Normal Cycle Designed for Energy Efficiency
Our normal cycle was specifically created to use the least energy possible to get a full load dry, so normal use puts less burden on the planet. There’s also a Dry Boost option, if you need.
10-Year Motor Warranty Plus Lifetime Tub Warranty
Rest easy knowing your washer is backed by a 10-year motor and lifetime tub warranty.
ENERGY STAR® Certified
Electrolux washer and dryer meet strict criteria to guarantee high-quality energy efficient performance--without sacrificing clean/dry.
Reversible Doors
Enjoy easy loading and unloading no matter where you place your Laundry Tower™, even if it's next to a wall or in a corner.
